Package planning

Class BFSPlanner

java.lang.Object
planning.BFSPlanner
All Implemented Interfaces:
Planner
public class BFSPlanner extends Object implements Planner
BFSPlanner is an implementation of the Planner interface that uses Breadth-First Search (BFS) to find a sequence of actions that transform the initial state of a Blocks World into the target goal state.

    • getBfsPlan

      public static List<Action> getBfsPlan(Map<Map<Variable,Object>,Map<Variable,Object>> father, Map<Map<Variable,Object>,Action> plan, Map<Variable,Object> goal)
      Constructs the BFS plan by backtracking from the goal state to the initial state.
      Parameters:
      father - a map tracking the parent of each state in the search tree
      plan - a map associating each state with the action that led to it
      goal - the goal state to backtrack from
      Returns:
      the ordered list of actions from the initial state to the goal state
